Sinara Pool Villas

Villa in Thalang
HomeNew ProjectsSinara Pool Villas

Marketing images, mostly artist renders. Layouts and finishes may differ from the final product.

Project overview

A six-villa low-density pool villa development of about 3,500 sqm in Khao Phra Thaeo, with large plots, floor-to-ceiling glazing and a greenery and stream setting. Villas come as 3BR or 4BR, each with a private pool and two parking spaces.

Facilities & amenities

  • 24/7 security
  • CCTV
  • Covered parking
  • Landscaped gardens
  • Swimming pool with poolside
  • Private 4x9 m pool per villa
  • EV charger readiness
  • Water filtration
